allowedSourceMaterial.overview: In 208 A.D., in the final days of the Han Dynasty, shrewd Prime Minster Cao convinced the fickle Emperor Han the only way to unite all of China was to declare war on the kingdoms of Xu in the west and East Wu in the south. Thus began a military campaign of unprecedented scale. Left with no other hope for survival, the kingdoms of Xu and East Wu formed an unlikely alliance.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Pushed to the brink of extinction, can two cautious kingdoms hold their ground against Cao's massive unified assault?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 208 A.D., Prime Minister Cao convinces the Han Emperor to wage an unprecedented war against rival southern and western territories, forcing the outnumbered kingdoms of Xu and East Wu into a desperate mutual defense.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, heavy historical action that demands engaged attention for massive battlefield stakes.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by John Woo, this sprawling historical epic delivers grand tactical warfare and high-stakes momentum as rival kingdoms unite to avert total annihilation.
